title: Lovecraftian horror game, how's the atmosphere?
author: ObviousPin2271
selftext:
A short look at something I'm working on.

Working on a dream solo project (although scope is pretty small, probably a 1-2 hour game)

I really love horror. I write short stories. I love atmospheric games with deep thematics. The game is going to be more psychological horror and introspective with puzzles.

I've been a game dev for a while, finally trying my hand at a solo project. I really love how much I can focus on creativity rather than fighting my lack of blender skills now with AI tools helping.

Does the atmosphere land?

comments.author: Stifmeista
comments.body: I think it looks great. how did you create the 3d statue? can llms help you with sculpting in blender? Or is it a dedicated 3d model ai?

replies.author: ObviousPin2271
replies.body: Thanks! Astra + Blender MCP! It took about 5 iterations. I generated some images and chose the one i liked. The eyeballs took a few tries.

replies.author: Stifmeista
replies.body: I wonder if Blender MCP is actually worth it. Astra can also use the Blender Python library directly. I will have to a/b test it I guess.

replies.author: ObviousPin2271
replies.body: Ya not really sure! Let me know. I'll test it as well
